title: MRR ReleaseRecord
description: docs/spec/adr/ADR-0011-RELEASE-RECORD-AND-A4-APPROVAL-EVENT.md decision 1, implemented per task-packets/E8-T04.yaml (Epic E8's fourth task; the thirtieth entity schema in this repository). Records ONE immutable, durable publication-approval act: a deterministic bundle (the E8-T01/T02 RO-Crate export plus the E8-T03 report renders) rooted at one sealed EvidenceCrate, approved by exactly one human. This is the A4 gate MRR-FR-101/-102 and Stage 11's acceptance criteria name ('an unapproved bundle cannot be published through any first-party connector'; 'historical releases' must be durable, not regenerable projections) — the object kind docs/spec/02_DOMAIN_MODEL.md section 2 does not itself define; ADR-0011 is the record of that extension. crate_id names the sealed EvidenceCrate this release is rooted on. disclosure ('internal'|'public') is the report projection actually rendered into the bundle (mrr.domain.research_report.Disclosure, MRR-FR-095). bundle is the deterministic content manifest: files (a SORTED array of {path, sha256}, one entry per content file the bundle directory carries) plus root_hash (sha256 over the sorted per-file hash lines — the bundle's own identity, ADR-0011 decision 1/3). The rule that makes this checkable ('immutable release'): root_hash covers every CONTENT file only and EXCLUDES release-manifest.json and release-record.json themselves (the two files that DESCRIBE the bundle, not its content — derived_decisions (c): the bundle embeds release-record.json verbatim so a third party holding only the bundle sees who approved and the hash it attests, and this exclusion is what makes that self-reference non-circular). approval is the A4 human act itself: approved_by is a PERSON urn (never an agent-role, node, or practice identity — MRR-FR-110 forbids inferring A4 permission from a lower-autonomy identity), pattern-enforced here to the exact person entity segment; approval_statement is the human's own words, non-empty; approval_mode names the vocabulary spec 01 section 5's autonomy model offers for an A4 act ('explicit human or dual approval') without this schema itself licensing a second-approver workflow — 'dual' is schema-valid but service-refused in this packet (task-packets/E8-T04.yaml derived_decisions (b)); the release.approved domain event's own actor field is this same approved_by value, atomically with this record's own revision-1 insert (ADR-0011 decision 2) — the human act IS the event, not a service default. status is 'released'|'superseded'; mrr.domain.lifecycles.RELEASE_RECORD_LIFECYCLE declares the single legal edge released -> superseded, driven only by a future E8-T05 (never by this packet — no ReleaseRecord this packet's own tests create is ever superseded). Release records are never edited, deleted, or re-released (ADR-0011 decision 1) — no update/delete method exists anywhere in mrr.services.release, immutability by omission, mirroring mrr.services.source_family.service.SourceFamilyService's own create-only precedent.

personUrn.description: ADR-0011 decision 1's own person-URN pattern for approval.approved_by: the exact urn shape common.schema.json#/$defs/urn already defines, with the entity segment LOCKED to the literal 'person' rather than the generic '[a-z0-9-]+'. The ULID character class below is the SAME one common.schema.json#/$defs/urn and mrr.domain.identity.URN_PATTERN already use, duplicated here (not $ref'd, since #/$defs/urn's own entity segment is not itself parameterizable inside a JSON Schema pattern) rather than widening the shared urn definition — a disclosed, minor duplication, mirroring mrr.domain.artifacts.Classification's own documented precedent for 'a small enum appearing in a third place, consistent with a pattern that already appears in two'.

path.description: Relative POSIX path from the bundle directory's own root, e.g. 'ro-crate/ro-crate-metadata.json', 'report.md'.

files.description: One entry per CONTENT file the bundle directory carries, SORTED by path — every file under ro-crate/ plus report.md and report.html, EXCLUDING release-manifest.json and release-record.json (ADR-0011 decision 1/3's own exclusion rule). Sortedness is enforced by the Pydantic contract (mrr.contracts.release_record.Bundle), not expressible cleanly as a JSON Schema constraint over array order.

root_hash.description: sha256 over the sorted per-file hash lines (mrr.services.release.manifest's own concrete, disclosed byte-format choice — the ADR names the rule, not the exact bytes) — the bundle's own identity, recomputed and never trusted from input at every boundary this packet defines (create, verify).

approval_statement.description: The human's own words recording why this release is approved. No default exists anywhere for this field (MRR-FR-102: supplying it IS the recorded human act).

approval_mode.description: 'single_human' is this practice's only IMPLEMENTED mode (task-packets/E8-T04.yaml derived_decisions (b)); 'dual' is schema-valid — recording the vocabulary docs/spec/01_SYSTEM_SPEC.md section 5's autonomy model offers ('explicit human or dual approval') — but service-refused, since no second-approver workflow exists yet.

crate_id.description: The sealed EvidenceCrate this release is rooted on (ADR-0011 decision 1).

disclosure.description: The report projection actually rendered into the bundle (mrr.domain.research_report.Disclosure, MRR-FR-095).

status.description: mrr.domain.lifecycles.RELEASE_RECORD_LIFECYCLE's single legal edge is released -> superseded, driven only by a future E8-T05 task.
